Engine Settings

Engine cascade: every order goes to ① Gemini first. If Gemini is rate-limited, out of quota, or down, the turn reruns on ② your Claude API key, then on ③ a local engine (bridge or LM Studio). At the next case it goes back to ①. An engine that hangs times out and hands over rather than freezing the sim.

→ Get a free Gemini key (aistudio.google.com/apikey · takes ~1 min). Free tier is ~20 requests/day (set the budget below); the cascade skips Gemini automatically once it's spent. Also powers HD character voices. Kept only for this browser session and cleared when the session closes.

→ Get a Claude API key (console.anthropic.com). Pay-per-use, no daily cap, ~2–6s/turn. Takes over the moment Gemini fails so the case never stalls. Kept only for this browser session and sent only to api.anthropic.com.

Tried automatically when ① and ② both fail: first the Claude subscription bridge (http://localhost:8787/v1, $0 extra, needs a one-time claude /login), then the LM Studio/Ollama server at the URL above.

Account

Signing in keeps your training log private to you and carries it to your other devices. It is separate from sharing case logs below, which sends orders and grading with no account attached.

LM Studio setup: Developer tab → Start Server (port 1234) → load your Qwen model → enable CORS in server settings (required so this page can reach it). Then click Detect above.
No key yet? A Gemini key is free — get one here and paste it into ① above. Your key remains in this browser session and calls the provider directly; no MediSim server receives it.
